## Acceptance smoke recipe

This skill's `assets/acceptance.json` MUST include at least one smoke
running:

```python
import lazyslide as zs
assert callable(zs.pp.find_tissues)
assert callable(zs.tl.feature_extraction)
assert callable(zs.tl.feature_aggregation)
assert callable(zs.tl.zero_shot_score)
```

Under `smoke_mode: "import_only"` this runs in < 5 s per CI invocation
and catches lazyslide upgrades that break the call surface.
